subject: Lumengrid vendor setup: W-9 OCR flag, video KYC option and PO activation
messages:
From: Cara Reyes <cara@lumengrid.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumengrid AP <ap@lumengrid.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Lumengrid W-9 attached (signed) — EIN display

Hi David,

Thanks for the onboarding checklist. Attached is our signed W-9 (Lumengrid_W9_signed.pdf). Our accounting system prints the EIN as 12-3456789 with a dash — we scanned and saved the form as a PDF. I noticed your portal flagged the OCR for mismatch (it removed the dash). I confirmed the EIN is 12-3456789.

We can also provide a bank letter if that helps speed things up — I attached a draft bank letter we can request from our bank (Lumengrid_BankLetter.pdf). If you still need a quick live verification, I can have our CFO join a 10–15 minute video call for identity confirmation.

What would you prefer so we can get the PO in place?

Regards,
Cara Reyes
Head of Finance
Lumengrid Inc.
[attachment: Lumengrid_W9_signed.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: Lumengrid_BankLetter.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Lumengrid W-9 attached (signed) — EIN display

Looping you in — the vendor portal (OCR) flagged Lumengrid's W-9 because the dashboard normalized the EIN without the dash and it didn't match our normalized IRS lookup (checksum check failed). Attached copy looks fine on visual inspection but the OCR tokenized the number differently.

Quick summary:
- External provided signed W-9 and optional bank letter.
- External offered video verification with CFO.
- We need to decide whether to accept bank letter as alternate evidence or run the quick video KYC.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement decide whether to create a provisional PO conditional on receiving bank letter and successful OCR manual pass.
2) If procurement prefers, schedule a 15-min video verification (CFO) to clear ID + EIN.

Monica — can you triage? Lauren — if we provisionally approve, please hold a PO number but mark as conditional (do not fund) until evidence is in.

Thanks,
David
David Kim | Senior Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Cara Reyes <cara@lumengrid.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-16T09:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumengrid W-9 attached (signed) — EIN display

Hi Cara — thanks for sending these so quickly and for offering the video option. Quick answers and a proposed path so we can unblock your timeline: 

1) Bank letter: we accept a bank-issued letter (on bank letterhead, dated within the last 90 days, containing the account name and EIN) as alternate evidence for EIN confirmation. Your attached draft looks like the correct format — please submit the bank-issued PDF when available.

2) Video KYC fallback: if the bank cannot provide a letter in the next 72 hours, a 10–15 minute video call with your CFO will suffice. During the call we will ask to see the signed W-9 and a government ID and capture the verifier name and timestamp in our audit log.

3) PO: Procurement can allocate a provisional PO number (PO-2026-0845-provisional) today and link it to HubSpot deal HS-47821. We will not release funds until evidence is submitted and verified. If you provide the bank letter before the end of week and OCR manual pass succeeds, we will flip the PO to active and confirm expected payment terms.

Action items for Lumengrid: 
- Provide bank-issued letter PDF OR confirm availability of CFO for a 15-min video slot (Mon–Fri 9–11am PT).
- If providing bank letter, please send to procurement@redwood.com and reply-all.

Cara — which option works best for you?

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Specialist | Redwood Inference
[Procurement note: provisional PO reserved as requested. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HS-47821]

From: Cara Reyes <cara@lumengrid.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Lumengrid AP <ap@lumengrid.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Lumengrid W-9 attached (signed) — EIN display

Monica / David — thanks, that works. Our bank can issue the letter by tomorrow morning; Ill route the official PDF to procurement@redwood.com and copy you both. If theres any additional formatting needed (specific line items or wording), let me know — otherwise well aim to get the signed bank letter to you by 9/18 10:00am PT.

Once you receive the bank letter, please let us know the PO activation condition and expected timeline for flipping the PO from provisional to active. We have a short onboarding sprint and a conditional PO would help our internal scheduling.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best regards,
Cara Reyes
Head of Finance
Lumengrid Inc.
[attachment stub: Lumengrid_BankLetter.pdf (to-follow from bank)]
